title: Composition of scalar unit comparisons on tensor-power zero
statement: Let T be a scheme, ell,r,m,n natural numbers with n ≤ m ≤ r, and A_i=ULift (ULift (ZMod (ell^i))). Let the scalarZeroLineIso maps be the canonical scalar unit maps transported through the single/unit isomorphisms, as defined in def-pur-finite-smooth-coefficient-arrows. Then ordinaryScalar(A_m→A_n) applied to scalarZeroLineIso(A_r→A_m).hom, followed by scalarZeroLineIso(A_m→A_n).hom, equals the ordinaryAssociator component on line(A_r,ell^r,0), followed by scalarZeroLineIso(A_r→A_n).hom. No primality, positive-index, geometric or root comparison assumption occurs.

source.place: Part (3), scalar/tensor associativity: unit case of the ordered root tensor-power induction.

proof.text: Compose the scalar tensor and unit isomorphisms for the two consecutive quotients. Naturality of the second tensor comparison and the constituent left-unit laws show that this composite satisfies the left-unit law. Binary scalar tensor coherence identifies it with the direct tensor comparison through the canonical scalar associator. The generic tensorIso_preserves_unit theorem therefore identifies the composite unit map with the direct unit map followed by the associator.

Transport this unit equality through the three single/unit isomorphisms. Functoriality cancels the middle inverse pair. Naturality of the scalar associator moves the source single/unit map to its right. The resulting equality is exactly the tensor-power-zero comparison. This last calculation is first proved in arbitrary categories so the specialized derived data need not be unfolded in its rewrite motives.

theorem ordinaryZeroTwistComp
    (T : Scheme.{u}) (ell : ℕ) {r m n : ℕ} (hmr : m ≤ r) (hnm : n ≤ m) :
    (ordinaryScalar (FiniteReduction.quotient ell hnm) T).map
        (scalarZeroLineIso (FiniteReduction.quotient ell hmr)
          (ell ^ r) (ell ^ m) (CharP.cast_eq_zero _ _) (CharP.cast_eq_zero _ _) T).hom ≫
      (scalarZeroLineIso (FiniteReduction.quotient ell hnm)
        (ell ^ m) (ell ^ n) (CharP.cast_eq_zero _ _) (CharP.cast_eq_zero _ _) T).hom =
    (ordinaryAssociator T ell hmr hnm).hom.app
        (line (coefficient ell r) (ell ^ r) (CharP.cast_eq_zero _ _) T 0) ≫
      (scalarZeroLineIso (FiniteReduction.quotient ell (hnm.trans hmr))
        (ell ^ r) (ell ^ n) (CharP.cast_eq_zero _ _) (CharP.cast_eq_zero _ _) T).hom
